{{Quote|I am Ako Domi, the lord of Camp 27. No one seeks me out.|Ako Domi|<ref name="Jailbreak" />}}
'''Ako Domi''' was a legendary [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who fought in the [[Battle of Sullust (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Sullust]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Domi was captured during the battle and imprisoned in various [[Prison/Legends|prisons]] until he was sent to the district of [[Shadow Town]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in [[3649 BBY]]. During that time, he fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and became a self-proclaimed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who ruled over the other inmates, two of which became his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]]. [[3643 BBY|Six years later]], Domi was later defeated by Republic operatives and returned to [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] for healing during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. While being cared for by Tython's best healers, he continued to profess that he was beyond redemption, but the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] continued to treat him since they felt that he wasn't lost to the Order forever and that the atrocities inflicted on him by the Empire would eventually be undone.<ref name="Jailbreak" />
